title: chiron viewer as-built UI map
purpose: Machine-readable map of the existing web viewer for a design agent optimizing typography and building theming: every surface, how the substrate data is partitioned across surfaces, every distinct text role with its current spec, and the full theme-token inventory. This documents web/ AS IT IS — the ideal data model lives separately in design/datamodel.json (grounded in methodology/, not in these types). Text roles reference datamodel entities via 'binds' and datamodel contentKinds via 'contentKind'.

stack.framework: Next.js 16 App Router / React 19, all pages force-dynamic (read from disk per request)
stack.styling: plain global CSS custom properties in web/app/globals.css (536 lines) + vendored github-markdown-css for article prose
stack.importOrder: github-markdown-css before globals.css so equal-specificity ties go to the app (web/app/layout.tsx:5-7)

layout.shell: Three-pane Reeder-style layout mounted once in the root layout: aside.sidebar | section.list-pane | main.article-pane, with draggable pane handles, IJKL/EDAF keymap (web/lib/reader.ts:216-227), pane widths and per-register scope persisted to localStorage
layout.articleMeasure: article pane content capped at max-width 860px, padding 26px 34px 64px (globals.css:131)
layout.responsive: one breakpoint @media (max-width: 880px): sidebar+list become fixed overlays behind a mobile toggle; article padding 48px 16px; NO type-size changes at any breakpoint (globals.css:523-536)

partitioning.description: How substrate data is sliced across surfaces today

slices.sidebar: registers + groups + counts only (identity and wayfinding; no linguistic content)
slices.list-pane: chapters of the active scope: title, number, defined-term and phrase counts (mentions excluded from counts, web/lib/workspace.ts:75)
slices.article-pane: exactly one chapter's generated markdown + a terms-in-chapter chip strip
slices.bit-modal: fully materialized, capped flashcards assembled server-side per request (web/lib/navigator.ts:351-360 caps: 3 anchors, 240-char quotes, 8 phrasings, 10 relations, 12 edges, 160-char glosses/details)
slices.command-palette: identity-only rows for everything (labels + kind + register key; no definitions, no anchors)
slices.chat-or-agent: none — no chat surface exists (removed; only the /api/navigate lookup round-trip uses the Agent SDK)

notSurfacedAnywhere: pipeline-rendered dimension pages: pages/README.md (index with GFM tables), pages/lexicon.md, pages/phrasebook.md, pages/relations.md — manifest declares them, no route reads them
per-chapter relation lists (the manifest carries only an edge COUNT, so relations cannot be listed per chapter)
anchors beyond the cap of 3 per card, and every anchor's path + curated_against pin
corpus.urls, corpus.source_kind, register checkout SHA, chapter.content_hash, chapter.kind, chapter.source_paths (all typed in web/lib/content.ts, never rendered)
term aliases as search keys (palette matches label text only)
any cross-register view ('same term in v1 vs v2' has no representation in the data model either)

fonts.--serif: "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
fonts.--mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

roleOfFaces.serif: identity face: wordmark, chrome h1/h2, card headwords, index card heads — always paired with --pine-dark
roleOfFaces.sans: everything else, including ALL article prose (chrome serif identity is reset inside .markdown-body, globals.css:395)

scales.chrome: body 15px/1.55 --sans; h1 28px, h2 19px (serif, --pine-dark, 600); code/pre 13px; NO h3–h6 rules (globals.css:78-107)
scales.article: vendored .markdown-body 16px/1.5 GitHub sans; em-relative headings h1 2em … h6 .85em / 600 / lh 1.25; code 12px
scales.note: two unreconciled scales — the central typographic tension

tokens.source: web/app/globals.css:10-72; dark values swap the same custom properties under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)

semantics.pine family: identity + interactive: links, headings, selection, focus ring, badges, anchor-quote rule
semantics.amber family: warning/drift: callouts, stale dots, error bars
semantics.surfaces: sidebar (gray) / list (white-ish) / article (pinned to github-markdown-css bg) / paper (cards) / inset (code) / well (quotes)
semantics.ink/muted: two-step text hierarchy — there is no third text color

accents.mechanism: group position within its corpus mod 5 → .accent-0…4 sets --accent (web/lib/content.ts:132-143, globals.css:423-427)

darkMode.mechanism: prefers-color-scheme only, declared independently in globals.css:43 and vendored github-markdown.css:14
seams: --bg-article pinned to github-markdown-css's background in both schemes so pane and markdown never seam (globals.css:21,55)
github-markdown-css ships unused [data-theme=dark]/[data-theme=light] hooks — the obvious seam for an explicit theme toggle

gaps: Two unreconciled type scales: chrome 15px base with serif/pine headings vs article 16px vendored GitHub sans with em-relative headings; the reset at globals.css:395 kills the identity face inside articles.
No h3–h6 rules at chrome level — cards and chrome never use heading elements below h2, and the vendored rules only apply inside .markdown-body.
No explicit theme toggle path: prefers-color-scheme only; the vendored [data-theme] hooks are unused; nothing sets color-scheme.

~40 lines of dead CSS from the removed dimension pages (globals.css:482-519: .term-detail, .term-slug, .anchor-list, …); survivors still used are .anchor-quote, .phrase-template, .relation-list, .relation-line.
GFM table styling shipped but unexercised — the only tables live in the unrouted pages/README.md.

Pipeline renders pages/{README,lexicon,phrasebook,relations}.md and the manifest declares them, but no route or loader in web/ reads corpus.pages at all; lib/reader.ts and lib/dimensions.ts still carry segment logic anticipating /lexicon|/phrasebook|/relations URLs that 404.

Manifest fields typed but never rendered: corpus.urls, source_kind, checkout, chapter.content_hash, chapter.kind, source_paths, anchor.path, anchor.curated_against — provenance the UI currently hides.
Type sizes never change at the one responsive breakpoint (880px).
No third text color: ink/muted is the entire text hierarchy outside the pine/amber identity colors.
